title: SREV-019 rename/link target length shape

rename_info_shape.description: FILE_RENAME_INFORMATION and FILE_LINK_INFORMATION are variable-size; FileNameLength is ULONG byte count; FileName[1] starts a wide-character payload

flt_parameters_shape.description: FLT_PARAMETERS.SetFileInformation.Length is the byte length of InfoBuffer; FltSetInformationFile Length is byte size; minifilters must use FltSetInformationFile and not ZwSetInformationFile for rename/link

unicode_string_carrier.description: File_RenameOperation converts the target FileName into a UNICODE_STRING whose Length field is USHORT bytes; the ULONG name length must fit into USHORT

gate_inventory.description: Reject FileNameLength==0, FileNameLength>MAXUSHORT, FileNameLength not WCHAR-aligned, and FIELD_OFFSET(...,FileName)+FileNameLength > SetFileInformation.Length before constructing the UNICODE_STRING

fail_closed_invariant.description: Shapes this parser cannot represent as UNICODE_STRING fail closed via the existing minifilter policy path

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: long rename/link attempts and malformed InfoBuffers fail closed; ordinary rename and hard-link operations still pass policy

contracts: ULONG FileNameLength must be range-checked before any cast to USHORT
Name bytes must fit inside SetFileInformation.InfoBuffer counted by SetFileInformation.Length
Odd byte lengths are rejected before the wide-character parser sees them
Zero-length name is rejected before UNICODE_STRING construction
